Nickname: Goode. Also described as biological maternal grandfather of Barbara McKeldin Adams and Chuck McKeldin Jr.

CORRECTION: died 9 May 1951 in Baltimore, in his 52nd year, per his death notice (Evening Sun, 10 May 1951) and Find a Grave; 12 May 1951 was his burial at New Cathedral Cemetery. Born 1 Jun 1899 in Baltimore.
In 1930 his mother-in-law Emily Cook and her husband Earnest Cook lived with the family on Barclay Street.

Son of Bartholomew Schriefer and Margaret (Denzlein), both born in Germany; in the 1900 census he is George S., aged 11 months, at 2531 E. Oliver Street. He married Ethel Elizabeth Quinn on 12 Jul 1920 in Baltimore (Quinn Family Tree on Ancestry; he was 20 at his first marriage, per the 1930 census).
George Schriefer (21, B&O Railroad) and Ethel Quinn (20), both of Baltimore, were married on 12 Jul 1920 at St. Paul's Church, Ellicott City, Howard County, by the Rev. Michael A. Ryan.
